title: Kiritani Haruka — Fantastic Training Room!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Pardon us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, the training room's open...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm glad we came early.
This means we should be able to exercise as much as we want.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We came at a good time! You've been saying how you've been wanting to try all those different machines.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. On the other hand, I didn't realize you were also interested in them, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because of how your eyes sparkled like crazy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't help but be curious since they must be super amazing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, they have so many state-of-the-art machines that I've never used before.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's Haruka!>
<And Minori's with her!>
<Are they here to train?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka, wait!
I think we're on camera right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're right.
Good morning, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Do we get to see you train, Haruka?>
<You were so excited about these machines the other day lol.>
<Got any exercises you recommend?!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exercises that I recommend...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I was actually just about to have her show me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, since we're all here, I'll do my best to commentate while we work out.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yes!>
<It's a training stream now!>
<I'm ready to learn, Ms. Haruka, lol!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I promise to make things easy to understand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's start by warming up on the treadmill.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is this a newer machine too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, the running belt is made of this high-tech material that's supposed to be more comfortable to run on.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: First, we'll use these for ten minutes to get our blood pumping.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try my best!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I'll lead by explaining what a good running form is. Feel free to give it a try when you can, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Next, we'll do chest presses.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only does this exercise help build your chest muscles, it's also a great way to tone your upper arms.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: First, you need to find the right height setting for yourself. Oh wow... It's so easy to adjust the seat!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She looks like she's having so much fun.>
<Look at the way her eyes are sparkling lol.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry about that...
I should keep explaining how to use this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I get the feeling that you need a lot of strength to use this machine. Do you think I'll be able to use it properly?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
With the right weight setting, you'll be fine.
Take a look at these numbers back here. Whenever you want to change...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Maintaining proper form is also key when you're on a stationary bike.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Keep your back straight and your hips steady, ideally while engaging your core.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you're pedaling, try to be aware of what your glutes and hip joints are doing instead of just focusing on your leg muscles.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Okay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She's talking so much while working out...>
<She's been talking for like twenty minutes now, right?>
<I can't believe she can chat while doing something so strenuous.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You really are amazing, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe we've had a chance to try everything now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I-I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
Did I go a little overboard?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You're so awesome, Haruka.>
<After all that, she seems totally fine.>
<So the rumors were true? She's basically a professional athlete...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you stick with it every day, you'll all be able to do this in no time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope you all get a chance to do the exercises we introduced today that don't involve any machines.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know it's hard to stick to a workout routine, so let's keep trying together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'll do my best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, I was impressed by every machine.
They were all so well designed and easy to use...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since I'm here, I might try setting the treadmill to hard mode.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you're gonna keep going?!
